profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer with a passion for Flutter development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed RTK map interaction features.
- Resolved bugs and implemented features across the application.
- Led the initiative to establish and expand automated testing coverage for the application.
- Led CI/CD improvements using GitHub Actions for testing and app flavors. 
- Contributed to the iOS implementation and expansion of AR functionality.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Proficiently managed a portfolio consisting of three Flutter mobile applications, an Angular web application, and a REST API, while overseeing the AWS infrastructure, demonstrating versatility in navigating various technologies and environments to deliver robust and scalable solutions.
 • Led the initiative for a product-wide upgrade of the AWS SDK, orchestrating seamless integration across multiple services and ensuring optimal performance, security, and scalability for the entire system.
 • Coordinated within an agile scrum team, using Git and Jenkins to contribute to continuous improvement and deployment (CI/CD).
 • Developed comprehensive testing suites for two mobile applications, meticulously covering hundreds of lines of code, ensuring thorough quality assurance and adherence to performance standards.
 • Designed and developed new Angular UI components, enhancing the user experience and streamlining interface functionality to align with project requirements and industry best practices.
 • Developed and implemented new REST API endpoints, leveraging best practices in design and functionality to enhance system capabilities and facilitate seamless interaction between client applications and backend services.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Reported bugs and enhanced the documentation as an early stage startup
•	Worked on critical bug fixes and new UI elements for production Flutter application

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked as a software engineering intern on a mobile app that focused on mock cryptocurrency trading
•	Worked on the existing app that uses the Flutter framework 
•	Helped to design and implement various new features for the app
•	Utilized Flutter, API’s, MVVM design, Android, and IOS
